title: Adaptive Retrieval helps Reasoning in LLMs -- but mostly if it's not used
authors: Srijan Shakya; Anamaria-Roberta Hartl; Sepp Hochreiter; Korbinian Pöppel
why_relevant: Studies adaptive retrieval as a metacognitive decision of when to retrieve, showing static retrieval injects noise while the model's choice to forgo retrieval correlates with confidence/correctness. Directly relevant to calibration/control (when to retrieve) and uncertainty-aware RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Small-scale empirical study on math benchmarks with a single 8B model; limited methodological novelty.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control: When to Retrieve
